name: Paletton
summary: Color wheel for designing palettes of one to four hues with five shades each, previewed in web, UI, photo and tartan mockups.
description: Web app for creating color combinations from a color wheel, using classical color theory and the RYB wheel: palettes of one to four hues, each in five shades. Preview styles show the palette on a website layout, UI, a photo and tartan fabric. Ships with Colorpedia, a wiki on color theory, perception and color blindness.
